{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    H,W=15,23
    g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # two horizontal full-width colored lines, ordered top to bottom
    r1=rng.randrange(3,7); r2=rng.randrange(9,15)
    while r2<=r1+2: r2=rng.randrange(9,15)
    c1,c2=rng.sample([1,3,5,8],2)
    for c in range(W): g[r1][c]=c1; g[r2][c]=c2
    # objects in regions: marker color matching one line, plus distractors/paired objects
    for _ in range(rng.randint(3,6)):
        r=rng.randrange(1,H-1); c=rng.randrange(W)
        if r in (r1,r2): continue
        # mostly isolated or short horizontal pair
        col=rng.choice([1,3,7])
        length=rng.choice([1,1,1,2])
        for j in range(length):
            if c+j<W and r not in (r1,r2): g[r][c+j]=col
    return g"}
